_readme: Defaults. Do NOT edit this file: copy it to config/theme.json (or run ./install.sh --configure) and change values there. Only options that really need a human decision are exposed here.
_mode: dark | light.  'light' is EXPERIMENTAL (palette is derived from the Figma light values, not verified on screen).
_accent: 'auto' = Figma accent for the mode (dark #0091ff, light #0088ff) or any #rrggbb.

border._doc: width 0 removes the border (title bar is then exactly 32 px; with a border Openbox makes it 33 px). 'auto' = white at 23%/14% in dark mode, black at 23%/14% in light mode. Or give #rrggbb.

window._corner_radius: picom radius for normal windows. Figma: 16 (title-bar window, 16.9 best-fit for its squircle) or 26 (toolbar window).

menu._rim: thin light edge ('glass rim') on menus.

fonts._doc: Figma text is 13 px = Inter 10 pt. mono 'Maple Mono NF' is downloaded by install.sh; any installed monospace family works.

dock._width: pixels, or 'auto' = apps x (icon + 9) + 20 as in the Figma dock.
dock._apps: Known ids: files, browser, settings, trash, downloads, ide (older ids finder, chrome, fdm, idea still work). Add your own with entries like {"name":"Terminal","exec":"qterminal","icon":"utilities-terminal"}.
